title: Shaded Beige Shower Curtain Rod Brackets, 1-Inch Rod, Wall-Mounted Solid Brass Pair, Allied Brass
description: Shower curtain rod brackets for mounting a shower curtain rod in the bathroom in Shaded Beige, which offers sophisticated warmth in a soft, neutral tone that complements natural materials and earthy palettes. This wall mount / wall-mounted bracket set is made from solid brass and is sold as a pair; installation hardware is included. Fits any 1-inch diameter shower rod (1 inch, 1-inch, 1in); shower rod is not included and must be purchased separately. Concealed screw mounting helps keep the traditional look clean once installed. Bracket dimensions: 3 inches L x 2.25 inches H x 3 inches W (3in x 2.25in x 3in) with 2-inch projection. Product weight 1.6 lb; weight capacity 2 lb.  and covered by a limited lifetime warranty. Coordinate with matching Prestige Regal collection pieces for classic bath accessories and traditional bathroom hardware.
